outline:
本課程除了介紹技術的原理之外，更著重在實際資安檢測工具的使用，以Kali Linux虛擬機實際進行實作分析與演練，讓學生能更了解技術原理的真實應用情境。課程內容包含：
●計算機網路回顧
●網頁安全
●滲透測試
●弱點評估及測試工具
●入侵偵測工具

In addition to introducing the principles of technology, this course also focuses on the use of actual security detection tools. It uses the Kali Linux virtual machine for actual implementation analysis and drills, so that students can better understand the real application scenarios of technical principles. Course content includes:

●Computer Network Review
●Web security: SQL injection, XSS attack, etc.
●Penetration test
●Vulnerability assessment and testing tools
●Intrusion detection tools
schedule:
1. Introduction to CryberSecurity and PenTest
2. Latest information security incidents

4. Basic exploit techniques (II)
5. Known and famous information security protection mechanisms
6. Social engineering based on Machine Learning
7. Web security - SQL injection (I)
8. Web security - SQL injection (II)
9. Mid-exam
10. Web security - XSS attack (I)
11. Web security - XSS attack (II)
12. Web security - CSRF attack
13. Web security - JWT vulnerability(I)
14. Web security - JWT vulnerability(II)
15. PenTest tools - practices (I)
16. PenTest tools - practices (II) & Presentation (I)
17. Presentation (II)
18. Presentation (III) & Conclusion
